verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent testing and evaluation platform, not an agent itself, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never documents a first-party Chronicle MCP server. The only MCP mention is that a custom environment version can describe user-supplied MCP servers inside a simulated world, which is an adjacent environment-building feature rather than an official MCP server an agent connects through.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
